register: Informal du with lowercase du/dein/dich/dir in running text (about 515 strings use du, about 60 use Sie/Ihr); German consumer apps and the rest of the catalog address the reader as du, so Sie/Ihr strings and strings that mix du and Sie are flagged (medium). Buttons and menu items stay infinitive or noun phrases (Website hinzufügen, Als gelesen markieren); instructions in sentences use the du imperative (Gib … ein, Wähle …).

terms.note: Catalog plurality (about 515 strings vs 475 Story and 95 Beitrag) and the standard term in German RSS readers (Feedly, Inoreader, Reeder, NetNewsWire). Artikel is masculine, so a switch from die Story changes articles and adjectives (dieser Artikel, einen Artikel, ein ungelesener Artikel). Compounds: Artikelliste, Artikeltitel, Artikelansicht, Artikel-Tags, Artikel-Trainer, Artikelgruppierung. 'Beitrag' stays only for a social post or a forum/blog post that is not a NewsBlur story.
Seite/Webseite are fine for a single web page (page-scraping, a page's HTML).
Compounds with a hyphen: Feed-Titel, Feed-Ansicht, Feed-Liste/Feedliste both tolerated, RSS-Feed, Web-Feed.
Expand folder → Ordner aufklappen (not erweitern).
Next unread story → Nächster ungelesener Artikel; Unread only → Nur ungelesene.

avoid: Artikel lesen (for the Read Stories folder)
terms.note: 'Read Stories' is the folder of stories already read: Gelesene Artikel, never the imperative. Siri/Spotlight 'Read %@' opens a feed to read it: %@ lesen. Mark newer/older as read → Neuere/Ältere als gelesen markieren.
Unsave → Speichern aufheben / Nicht mehr speichern.

avoid: Freigabe (for sharing a story to the Blurblog)
terms.note: A share of a story is 'geteilter Artikel'; '%d shares' → '%d-mal geteilt' or 'Mal geteilt'. 'Freigabe' reads as permission/release; tolerated only where it already reads naturally (Freigabe löschen for Delete share is acceptable).
Product name, kept in Latin script; catalog majority uses masculine (deinen Blurblog).

Intelligence training in prose → Intelligenztraining (tolerated: Training). Train this site/story → Diese Website/Diesen Artikel trainieren. Story trainer → Artikel-Trainer. Train intelligence → Intelligenz trainieren.

avoid: fokussieren (as a verb label for Focus stories)
terms.note: Slider: Alle / Ungelesen / Fokus. Focus stories → Fokus-Artikel; Focus view/mode → Fokusansicht/Fokusmodus; Unread + Focus → Ungelesen + Fokus. In prose 'focus on what matters' may stay 'sich auf … konzentrieren'.

terms.use: Gefällt mir / Gefällt mir nicht / Gefällt mir gar nicht
terms.note: Super dislike → Gefällt mir gar nicht (noun: ein „Gefällt mir gar nicht“). The trainer's 'beats' means Like outranks Dislike: schlägt / hat Vorrang vor. '(like wins)' → (Gefällt mir hat Vorrang). Thumbs up/down in marketing prose may stay Daumen hoch/runter.
Also avoid where it means this concept: verbergen.
Catalog plurality (27 vs 21). Prompt classifier → Prompt-Klassifikator; Regex classifiers → Regex-Klassifikatoren.

terms.use: Premium / Premium Archive / Premium Pro / Archive / Pro
terms.note: Plan names stay in English as product names, matching the App Store and Play Store products and the catalog plurality (Premium Archive 28 vs Premium-Archiv 25). Compounds with a hyphen: Premium-Abo, Archive-Tarif, Pro-Tarif. The story archive feature itself (not the plan) is Archiv. Generic lowercase 'premium feature/account' → Premium-Funktion / Premium-Konto. Also avoid where it means this concept: Premium-Archive.
Both Preferences and Settings → Einstellungen on all platforms.

terms.use: abonnieren / Abonnement (Abo in tight space) / Abonnent

terms.note: Catalog plurality. Lowercase 'your river' → dein Nachrichtenstrom; river view → Nachrichtenstrom-Ansicht.

avoid: Alle Artikel der Website (reads as all stories of one site)
terms.note: It is the river of every subscribed site, not all stories of one site.

Zusammenfassung is reserved for summaries (Ask AI summaries, the briefing's summary style and length), so it must not name the briefing. Morning/Afternoon/Evening Briefing → Morgen-/Nachmittags-/Abendbriefing; Weekly → Wochenbriefing. 'Brief' (a summary length) → Kurz; 'Editorial' (a narrative briefing style) → Redaktionell/Erzählend.

avoid: Schlagwort (in UI labels for NewsBlur tags)
terms.note: Story tags → Artikel-Tags; Saved story tags → Tags gespeicherter Artikel.
Catalog mixes ähnlich and verwandt; ähnlich is the natural UI word.

I'm Following → Ich folge; Following Me → Meine Follower (the tab beside Ich folge; 'Folgen mir' reads as an imperative). Button state Following → Folge ich (the established German social-app label). Ask AI follow-up → Nachfrage / Folgefrage.
iOS-Mitteilungen tolerated when it names Apple's own iOS notifications.

avoid: Artikel von selten besuchten Websites (wrong: rarely visited)
Seltene Beiträge dieser Website (wrong: this site)
terms.note: Stories from sites that publish rarely, not sites the reader rarely visits. In prose 'von selten aktiven Websites' is fine. The threshold setting 'Infrequent stories per month' → Grenze für selten aktive Websites (its options stay '< 5 Artikel/Monat').

terms.concept: Good Reads / Long Reads / Widely Read
terms.use: Gute Lektüre / Lange Artikel / Viel gelesene Artikel
terms.note: Good Reads is a folder of good stories, not books or ratings.
Original site → Originalwebsite.
Descriptive feature name, translated; in prose quote it as „KI fragen“. Full sentences like 'Stelle der KI Fragen' are fine when not naming the feature.

terms.use: Konto / Anmelden / Abmelden / Registrieren / Konto erstellen
terms.note: User → Nutzer (catalog majority) or Benutzer in Benutzername. Also avoid where it means this concept: Account.
Catalog majority on web and Android. iOS keeps Tastenkombinationen (close to Apple's own wording) without being flagged.
Catalog majority (29 vs 11).
Story clustering → Artikelgruppierung; clustered stories → gruppierte Artikel.

terms.use: German quotes „…“, single ‚…‘ inside; ellipsis … attached without space in menu labels (Ordner umbenennen…); no space before ?!:;; nouns capitalized; compounds joined or hyphenated; sentence case labels (no English Title Case); thousands separator . and decimal ,; currency after the number with a space (36 $)
terms.note: Typography is mostly clean; ellipsis spacing ('umbenennen …' vs 'umbenennen…') is tolerated and not flagged on its own.
